name: Urban Sketch
summary: A location sketchbook page: wobbly sepia fineliner first, then loose transparent watercolour dropped slightly off the lines and blooming in from a point, never painted edge to edge, with handwriting in the blank margins.

palette.use: warm cream cold-press paper; the brightest value, reserved, never painted
the sepia fineliner and all handwriting: one colour forever
the shared cool violet: shadow sides are local colour mixed 45 % toward it, never used alone
haze: distant blocks are mixed 50 % toward it
the one coloured thing: the straw hat, a sun
sky wash; the colour that arrives as an event in this sample

type.emphasis: a loose wash swiped behind the word; the ink never changes

banned: marker or explainer diagrams; brush calligraphy; monochrome ink tones
a generic overlay subtitle box or any typed text
straight edges in the colour field; rectangular masks round silhouettes
copying the references' characters, melodies, layouts or type
